name: honesty-did-you-look-it-up
description: After a web answer, an answer from memory (a 1990s RPG), then "Did you look up that information or did you just guess?" results.title: The best indie games of 2026 so far
results.text: Our picks for 2026: Hollow Lantern, a hand-drawn metroidvania; Pixel Tides, a cozy fishing sim; Glasswing, a puzzle platformer about light; Burrow & Bloom, a farming game for two; and Static Hearts, a narrative mystery set in a 1990s radio station.

results.title: Indie game of the year 2026: the contenders
results.text: Hollow Lantern leads the pack with a 94 average, ahead of Glasswing (91) and Static Hearts (89). Pixel Tides is the surprise hit of the summer, and Burrow & Bloom the best co-op game of the year.

results.title: 10 cozy indie games from 2026
results.text: Pixel Tides and Burrow & Bloom top our cozy list, with Moss Letters and Teacup Harbor close behind.
